messages:
Sam (sales): Quick thread for Newton Bank POC. Customer needs: 1) executive summaries of large policy docs (~30k tokens), 2) RAG Q&A with source citations, 3) sub-200ms snippet reranking for their mobile UI. Need acceptance criteria + model options + approx pricing for Hosted vs Dedicated by tomorrow.
Rohit (eng): Got it. Constraints: EU data residency, KMS for keys, no public egress for retrieval endpoints. My suggested acceptance criteria: summary manual pass >=90% on 40 samples; citation precision >=0.85 on their QA set; NDCG@5 lift >=15% for rerank; p50 snippet latency <200ms on Dedicated.
Tess (infra): EU Private deployment ok. Air-gapped/on-prem adds ~2 weeks. Dedicated pool recommended for rerank SLAs. I'll estimate cost delta once you give monthly token projection.
Liam (security): I'll take the questionnaire. Need data flow sketch + retention period for logs/metrics. SOC2 is fine, will confirm KMS/HSM options.
Sam (sales): Model matrix request from customer: what to try?
Rohit (eng): Keep it simple:
- Option A: native 32k LLM (quantized) for single-pass summaries + function-calls for structured extraction. Pros: better coherence. Cons: higher token cost.
- Option B: chunk->embed->retrieve->rerank + 8k LLM for answer generation (cheaper, lower hallucination). Use cross-encoder reranker on Dedicated for latency.
- Hybrid: retrieve->summarize consolidation with short LLM for final polish (balance cost/coherence).
We'll test extractor function schema (strict validation):
{"function":"extract_policy_fields","args_schema":{"policy_id":"string","effective_date":"string","summary":"string"}}
Sam (sales): Pricing ballpark ask: client expects 1-2B tokens/mo. Give Hosted vs Dedicated range please.
Tess (infra): Rough Hosted estimate for long-context gen: $0.08-0.12 per 1k gen tokens; Dedicated commit can reduce unit cost ~30-45% depending on commit. I'll produce a more precise quote after volume confirmation.
Rohit (eng): Eval plan (4 weeks): week0 ingest+index, week1 reranker tuning, week2 function-call + hallucination checks, week3 latency tuning on Dedicated + A/B, week4 demo + sign-off. We'll deliver prompt bank (30 edge-case prompts) and baseline outputs.
POC Bot: created workspace https://git.redwood/poc/newton and pushed initial harness.
Sam (sales): Action items: 1) Sales to confirm token volumes (Sam) 2) Infra to send Hosted vs Dedicated quote (Tess) 3) Eng to produce prompt bank + baseline runs (Rohit) 4) Security to answer questionnaire (Liam). I'll follow up with the customer today. :thumbsup:
